title: Advance affordable housing
description: Make stronger progress on affordable housing (bezahlbarer Wohnraum) in Bern, a central plank of her programme and her mayoral campaign.
reasoning: A long-standing, repeatedly stated priority backed by her role as former tenants'-association president; concrete city-wide delivery over the term is not yet measurable.
key_evidence: Named affordable housing among priorities she wants to push in the executive (Journal B, Oct 2024)
Wikipedia lists promotion of affordable housing as part of her political programme

title: Drive the energy transition (Energiewende)
description: Push forward the city's energy transition as one of her named priorities for the term.
reasoning: Explicitly listed as a priority; implementation spans multiple directorates and is early in the term.
key_evidence: Listed Energiewende among areas that must move forward (Journal B, Oct 2024)

title: Make Bern a heat-resilient, climate-friendly city
description: Pursue concrete measures against climate warming and adapt the city to heat (hitzevertraegliche Stadt), including greening of public space, framed as central to her mayoralty.
reasoning: Repeatedly emphasised; some projects (square redesigns) already exist, but city-wide heat-resilience goals are long-term.
key_evidence: Said her special focus is on climate, in both senses (Journal B, Oct 2024)
Cited Breitenrainplatz as a model and called for more such places

title: Promote city-compatible transport
description: Continue promoting city-compatible transport (stadtvertraeglicher Verkehr), including cycling and public transport, building on her record as transport director.
reasoning: Consistent with her directorate record; cycling-network expansion was reported as about one-third complete, so work continues.
key_evidence: Listed promotion of city-compatible transport among priorities (Journal B, Oct 2024)
Cited cycle-network expansion and traffic-calming as transport director (Nau.ch, Sep 2024)

title: Strengthen equal opportunities
description: Increase equal opportunities (Chancengerechtigkeit) and work towards an open, diverse and non-discriminatory city.
reasoning: Stated value and priority; broad and hard to measure within the early term.
key_evidence: Listed Chancengerechtigkeit among priorities (Journal B, Oct 2024)
Described 20-year vision of a diverse, non-discriminatory city

title: Stronger cross-departmental cooperation and a 'big picture' view
description: Pledged more binding cross-departmental cooperation in the executive on key future issues (heat-resilient city, business-friendliness, digitalisation) and a stronger focus on the city as a whole.
reasoning: A governance intention as incoming mayor; outcomes depend on collegial executive practice and are not yet documented.
key_evidence: Said the executive needs a stronger view of the big picture and more binding cross-departmental cooperation (Journal B, Oct 2024)

title: Maintain stable city finances
description: Ensure stable municipal finances as the basis for future projects and social balance.
reasoning: Stated as a condition for her other goals; fiscal outcomes over the term are not yet assessable.
key_evidence: Said only with stable finances does the city have room for future projects and social balance (Journal B, Oct 2024)

title: Develop high-quality new neighbourhoods (e.g. Ausserholligen)
description: Advance the development of livable new neighbourhoods such as Ausserholligen, with dense but green design, short distances and a mix of housing, work, education and culture.
reasoning: Specific project cited as an example of her ambitions; multi-year development whose progress is not yet measurable.
key_evidence: Cited Ausserholligen as an example of a new neighbourhood with high quality of life to advance (Journal B, Oct 2024)
